data.credibility: Management generally delivers on operational efficiency targets like working capital and margins, though revenue growth occasionally misses guidance. They tend to raise successful metrics while quietly dropping unmentioned targets in later quarters.

lines.line: Promised 10% inflow growth for FY26; raised in Q3 and delivered.
Promised 15% revenue growth for FY26; missed with actual 11.8%.
Promised 12% Net Working Capital ratio; heavily outperformed, delivering 4.1%.
Promised 8.3% to 8.5% margin; delivered an actual 12.6%.
Promised 10% to 12% FY27 order inflow growth; currently on track.
Promised 10% to 12% FY27 revenue growth; tracking at 11.4%.
Promised stable 7.8% margin for FY27; tracking at 11.6%.
Promised ~10% working capital in FY27; currently on track.
Targeted 10% to 12% inflow CAGR under Lakshya 31; status is pending.
Targeted 12% to 15% revenue CAGR under Lakshya 31; status is pending.

bull: Revenue compounded at 16.0% annually over five years, supported by large infrastructure order wins totaling 1,99,064 crore in FY26.
Operating cash flow reached 115% of reported profit over five years, proving high cash conversion.
Working-capital days drastically tightened from 28 to -27 over five years, alongside a low Net Working Capital ratio of 4.1%.
bear: EBITDA margin narrowed from 17.3% in FY21 to 12.7% in FY26.
The balance sheet is heavily geared with borrowings of ₹140,300 cr against net worth of ₹113,029 cr, yielding a high debt-to-equity ratio of 1.24.
Net profit growth lagged significantly behind revenue, compounding at only 8.0% over five years despite 16.0% revenue compounding.
